objects: lead white car and receding row with check badges
actions: April calendar page tears off and shows the date 20 from 46.4 s, then the old page slides upward at 46.6 and 46.8 s
text: and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.
observed: Frames 46.0 to 46.8 s. The calendar at right flips from a blank April page to a page showing 20 at 46.4 s, and the old page lifts upward off the pad in later frames. Cars with check badges, the wire cards and the caption stay unchanged. Lower area is wet asphalt with a reflection.
